text: The chloride deposition rate (maximum, DP-OWNR-0007) and the sea-salt aerosol concentrations (annual mean DP-OWNR-0006, event maximum DP-OWNR-0005) are the design basis for equipment enclosures, air intakes, insulation cladding and electrical equipment. Air intake filtration of rotating machines shall be designed for the sea-salt event value, including fine salt mist and PM10 events (DP-OWNR-0008).
